_readme: S740 (the census's reconcile_steps lever, lane 1 `reconcile`). Norco's curriQunet pages print a figure over Required Courses that the rows under it do not add to as the capture's text gives them: Philosophy A.A.-T prints 'Units: 9.00' over two 'Choose one course' groups of 3.00 (PHI-10, PHI-10H, PHI-12; PHI-32, MATH-32), and Drafting Technology prints 'Units: 14.00-15.00' over four 'Select one of the following' groups that add to 11-12 (college-page-read run 45835049303). The text is flat, so a row that follows a group may be a required course of its own. This read prints the page's own data around those rows, as its scripts fetched it, so the session sees whether the catalog marks where a group ends. Two loads, no model call, nothing written.

questions.group_end: Does the page's own data mark which rows belong to a 'Choose one course' group and which follow it as required courses?
